import re
import sys

values = {}
instruction = re.compile(r"\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*<-\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP|\d+)\s*;\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = instruction.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        values[target] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "TMP")) + ";")
